sources.observation: Index-specific stored magnitude is read during image retrieval; setter writes cache. Actual worker timing not experimentally tested.
Current training-view output supplies entropy, then index cache is written before optimizer update; loader uses8workers. This alone does not prove a performance defect.
SRA already explicitly identifies non-real-time EntAugment feedback as a concern and motivates current-model refinement. Therefore generic feedback-lag novelty is rejected.
